method: A grid cell belongs to the area whose geoBoundaries boundary contains the cell centre. A variable is covered when at least 50% of the variable's cells in the area's bounding box belong to the area and carry a usable series (an ADM2 area needs one such cell, since those polygons are usually smaller than the grids). The NASA analysis grids used here cover South Asia only, so countries outside their extent have no measured coverage. Coverage is not a weather value and no weather value is invented for an area that lacks one.

dry-spell.name: Dry spells
dry-spell.rule: Covered when at least 50% of the variable's grid cells in the area's bounding box lie inside the boundary and carry a value for 10+ years from 2014. An ADM2 area is covered when at least one such cell centre falls inside it.
